subject: Eval playbook: commitments, ramp timing, and incentive proposal
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Harmon <kate.harmon@elliotsys.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@elliotsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Eval playbook & MAP draft — proposed checkpoints and metrics

Hi Kate / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the walkthrough yesterday. Attached is a first-pass evaluation playbook and a short MAP draft that ties acceptance checkpoints to ramp commitments. The goal here is to keep the evaluation fast (6–8 weeks) while giving you predictable economics if you convert to a committed plan.

Highlights in the attached workbook:
- Proposed checkpoints: P0 (integration smoke) -> P1 (latency/cost baselines) -> P2 (quality validation on 5 production prompts) -> P3 (proof-of-concept scale test).
- Suggested timing: 2 weeks / 2 weeks / 2 weeks / 2 weeks (flexible).
- Pricing preview for eval stage (consumption-only) and two committed tiers (3-month ramp & 6-month baseline).

Two asks from you to finalize before Marissa and I run a pricing iteration:
1) Confirm the P2 prompt set (we can use your five priority prompts or we can import the set you shared).
2) Are you open to a structured ramp: 0–30% of target throughput month 1, 60% month 2, 100% month 3 — we can attach volume discounts tied to each checkpoint.

Attachment: 20261101-eval-metrics.xlsx

I added Marissa on this thread to propose the commercial tweaks once you confirm the prompts/timing.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[rachel.kim@redwood.ai]

From: Kate Harmon <kate.harmon@elliotsys.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@elliotsys.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Eval playbook & MAP draft — proposed checkpoints and metrics

Rachel —

Thanks, this is very clear. A few quick items from our side:
- We will use the five prompts we shared in the sandbox; I confirmed with ML Ops.
- The ramp profile you proposed works for us, but we need a cap on monthly spend during month 1 just to limit risk (we're thinking $12k).
- For incentives: is there flexibility on a one-time onboarding credit if we sign the MAP within two weeks of P0 completion?

Also, can you add a short clause that the P2 quality checks will use the exact prompt+post-process we agreed on? We need reproducibility for procurement.

If you can send a revised pricing sheet with those two items (month 1 cap + onboarding credit) we'll share with procurement.

—Kate
Director, Product — Elliot Systems
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T08:35:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Eval playbook & MAP draft — Elliot asks (onboarding credit + month1 cap)

Marissa / Karthik —

Kate asked for two small commercial updates: a month-1 spend cap ($12k) and a short onboarding credit if they sign MAP within two weeks after P0. They also want the P2 quality clause locked to the exact prompt+post-process.

Can you review and propose a pricing revision that: (a) keeps the 6–8 week eval timeline, (b) shows the month-1 cap option, and (c) includes a discrete onboarding credit (we've typically done $10k or a % credit). I'm thinking we can offer $8k credit and 15% ramp discount tied to 6-month commit. If that looks risky, flag it so I can push back with customer.

I attached the original MAP for context.

Attachment: redwood-MAP-v2.pdf

Thanks — appreciate a quick turn (by EOD Monday).
Rachel
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Eval playbook & MAP draft — Elliot asks (onboarding credit + month1 cap)

Rachel —

Attached is a revised pricing workbook with two scenarios:
Scenario A (Conservative): $8k onboarding credit, month-1 cap $12k, no extra ramp discount beyond standard tiered pricing.
Scenario B (Aggressive): $10k onboarding credit, month-1 cap $12k, plus an additional 10% ramp discount if Elliot commits to a 6-month minimum that hits the target throughput by month 3.

I called out the margin impact on the second tab. My recommendation is Scenario B if we want to protect deal velocity; it's within playbook bounds for strategic accounts.

Attachment: 20261115-revised-pricing.xlsx

If Karthik gives the green light on the incremental 10% ramp discount, I'll prepare the MAP with explicit language for P2 reproducibility and the onboarding credit trigger.

—Marissa
Senior Director, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Kate Harmon <kate.harmon@elliotsys.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@elliotsys.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T10:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Eval playbook & MAP draft — proposed checkpoints and metrics

Rachel / Marissa —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Elliot prefers Scenario B — the larger onboarding credit plus the extra ramp discount tied to a 6-month commit is what will help us get procurement over the line.

Two final asks before procurement signs:
1) Can you add a short reproducibility clause on P2 that references the exact prompt list + post-processing hash?
2) We need the eval dashboard shared to our team for P1/P2 monitoring (read-only).

If you can send a DocuSign link for the MAP with those two items, procurement will push through approvals this week.

Best,
Kate
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Harmon <kate.harmon@elliotsys.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@elliotsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Eval playbook & MAP draft — proposed checkpoints and metrics

Kate —

Great — thanks for confirming Scenario B.

Per Marissa's note, Karthik approved the incremental 10% ramp discount to accelerate conversion for strategic accounts. Quoted here from Karthik: 

"Approved. 10% additional ramp discount contingent on signed 6-month commit that achieves target throughput by month 3. Legal to include the P2 reproducibility clause exactly as drafted."

Next steps:
- I uploaded a read-only eval dashboard: https://app.redwood.ai/eval-dashboard/E-3472 (access shared with kate@elliotsys.com and tom.wu@elliotsys.com).
- DocuSign link for the MAP (includes onboarding credit, month-1 cap, P2 reproducibility clause): https://docusign.net/share/E-3472-MAP
- Once signed, we'll enable the onboarding credit within 3 business days and schedule a kickoff with our integration team.

Attachments: redwood-MAP-v2.pdf (finalized with the reproducibility clause)

If procurement needs any minor redlines, loop me and Marissa directly — we can triage. Looking forward to getting you started.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[rachel.kim@redwood.ai]
